name: elizaOS
description: TypeScript framework and product stack for autonomous agents, including a core runtime, the Eliza app, a CLI and plugins.
whatItDoes: Runs autonomous agents extended through first-party plugins, with an app, cloud services and native bridges in one monorepo. Suited to developers who want to operate their own persistent agents.
howItWorks: The monorepo is installed with Bun, which also prepares submodules and local inference components. A dev command starts the stack from source, and an embedding model is downloaded at first local-inference warmup.

requirements.name: Bun and Node.js
requirements.description: Versions are pinned in the repository's package.json
